hero.title: Trade endless scroll for real life.
hero.subtitle: With Vemluz, you retake control before you scroll — a Screen Time barrier between you and the feed.

problem.title: The problem
problem.lead: Endless scroll takes hours you never meant to give.
items: You open an app “for a second” and lose half an hour to the feed.
Notifications yank you out of work, study, or a conversation.
Late-night scrolling eats sleep before you notice.
Without a barrier, intention loses to the next swipe.

consequences.title: If nothing changes
consequences.lead: The cost is quiet — and measurable.
items: Less deep work; more half-finished days.
Worse sleep when the phone is the last thing you see.
People in front of you compete with a glowing feed.
Weeks pass with the same “I’ll fix it tomorrow.”

solution.title: The solution: Vemluz
solution.lead: Authorize Screen Time, pick apps, Vemluz blocks them. A challenge to open. A short session. Then it locks again. Your home screen shows real usage.

items.title: App blocking
items.text: Protected apps sit behind Apple Screen Time until you earn an opening.

items.title: Challenge before open
items.text: Sort balls, word search, three breaths, tile match, mahjong, flow, or a Bible verse — then you may open.

items.title: Short session + reblock
items.text: A limited unlock. When time is up, Vemluz locks the app again.

items.title: Sleep Mode
items.text: After bedtime, protected apps stay blocked until morning.

items.title: Daily limit
items.text: A ceiling on openings. Hit it, and Vemluz stops releasing apps for the day.

pro.title: Free vs Pro
pro.lead: Start free. Go Pro when one app isn’t enough.
items: Live hour — one free hour at once

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what data Vemluz collects, why we collect it, and how it is handled. We only collect the minimum needed to provide the service.

collection.title: Data we collect
collection.body: We collect the email you use to create your account and the information needed to activate and maintain your Vemluz Pro subscription. We do not sell or rent your personal data.

payments.title: Payments
payments.body: Payments made on the website are processed by Stripe. Purchases made inside the iOS app are processed by Apple through In-App Purchase. Card details are handled directly by these providers and are never stored by Vemluz. We only receive your subscription status and basic transaction details.

affiliates.title: Affiliate program
affiliates.body: We use FirstPromoter to track affiliate referrals. When you arrive through an affiliate link, a cookie records the referral source, and when you subscribe your email is shared with FirstPromoter solely to attribute the commission.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We keep your data while your account is active, or for as long as legal, tax, and accounting obligations require. After that, it is deleted or anonymized.

security.title: Security
security.body: Data is transmitted over encrypted connections and stored with providers that enforce access controls. Internal access is limited to what is strictly necessary.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may request access to, correction, portability, or deletion of your data, and withdraw consent, under the GDPR, CCPA, and other applicable laws. To exercise these rights, email support@break.app.

terms.title: Terms
terms.body: Vemluz Pro is an annual subscription billed at $49.99 USD unless otherwise stated at checkout. Pro status syncs to the Vemluz iOS app when you sign in with the same email. Refunds follow the payment provider policies applicable to your purchase.

support.title: Support
support.body: Need help with your account or Pro status? Email support@break.app with the email you used at checkout.
